symptom: Abnormal noise or vibration during travel
evidence: Noise or vibration observed during operation
possible_causes: Bearing wear; alignment issue; mechanical looseness; traction-system wear
maintenance_check: Visual/condition inspection and comparison with normal operating behavior
recommended_action: Record condition and refer to the OEM maintenance procedure for qualified inspection

symptom: Oil leakage or abnormal oil level
evidence: Visible leakage or oil level outside OEM range
possible_causes: Seal deterioration; lubrication issue; component leakage
maintenance_check: Inspect for leakage and verify level against the model-specific specification
recommended_action: Qualified maintenance inspection; repair/replace affected component according to OEM procedure

evidence: Stopping behavior differs from normal operation
possible_causes: Brake wear; contamination; adjustment issue; brake-control fault
maintenance_check: Inspect brake condition and operating status using the OEM procedure
recommended_action: Remove elevator from service if safety performance is abnormal and escalate to qualified personnel

evidence: Visible wear compared with OEM limit
possible_causes: Normal deterioration; high operating frequency; contamination
maintenance_check: Compare lining condition/thickness with the applicable OEM limit
recommended_action: Replace or service according to the exact OEM/model procedure

symptom: Doors do not open or close normally
alarm: Door fault / safety-chain fault if reported
evidence: Door movement is slow, incomplete, noisy, or inconsistent
possible_causes: Door operator issue; track/roller wear; obstruction; sensor or interlock issue
maintenance_check: Observe door operation and inspect accessible door components and safety signals
recommended_action: Keep the elevator out of normal service if the door safety function is abnormal; qualified inspection required

symptom: Elevator refuses to run with doors apparently closed
evidence: Door appears closed but controller does not confirm lock
possible_causes: Interlock contact issue; alignment problem; wiring/signal issue
maintenance_check: Qualified technician checks door-lock status and safety-chain diagnostics
recommended_action: Do not bypass the safety circuit; diagnose using the OEM procedure

symptom: Car stops above or below floor level
possible_causes: Leveling sensor/target issue; control calibration issue; mechanical movement issue
maintenance_check: Check leveling behavior and relevant sensors/targets against OEM specifications
recommended_action: Qualified maintenance inspection and model-specific adjustment

evidence: Fault repeats after reset or during similar operating conditions
possible_causes: Electrical fault; drive overheating; motor/load issue; feedback fault
maintenance_check: Review fault history, operating symptoms, temperature and controller diagnostics
recommended_action: Use OEM fault-code documentation; escalate repeated trips rather than repeatedly resetting

possible_causes: Motor/drive electrical fault; abnormal load; mechanical resistance
maintenance_check: Correlate current trend with temperature, drive diagnostics and mechanical observations
recommended_action: Stop normal operation when protection trips repeatedly and perform qualified diagnosis

symptom: Motor current rises with increasing temperature
evidence: Current and temperature trends rise together
possible_causes: Cooling problem; electrical loading; motor/drive fault
maintenance_check: Review thermal trend, cooling condition and drive diagnostics

symptom: Irregular speed or leveling with feedback-related fault
evidence: Fault history plus abnormal speed/position feedback
possible_causes: Feedback device issue; connection problem; alignment/configuration issue
maintenance_check: Review controller diagnostics and feedback status using OEM procedure
recommended_action: Qualified technician inspection; do not alter safety-critical parameters without OEM authorization

symptom: Safety-related fault or abnormal governor condition
evidence: Controller records safety-chain interruption or inspection identifies abnormal condition
possible_causes: Governor/safety device issue; switch/contact issue; mechanical condition
maintenance_check: Inspection by qualified personnel according to applicable OEM and safety requirements
recommended_action: Keep elevator out of service until the safety issue is resolved and required tests are completed

symptom: Poor housekeeping, water ingress, or inadequate ventilation
evidence: Visible dust/oil/water ingress or ventilation problem
possible_causes: Environmental condition; housekeeping issue; building envelope/ventilation problem
maintenance_check: Inspect room condition, lighting, ventilation and signs of leakage
recommended_action: Correct environmental issue through qualified maintenance/building personnel

symptom: Visible rope wear, contamination, or abnormal tension indication
evidence: Inspection identifies wear, contamination, or uneven condition
possible_causes: Normal wear; contamination; unequal tension; traction-system condition
maintenance_check: Inspect rope condition and compare with OEM acceptance criteria
recommended_action: Qualified rope inspection and service according to the exact OEM procedure

possible_causes: Power issue; communication device fault; wiring/network issue
maintenance_check: Perform functional test and inspect the communication system
recommended_action: Restore the emergency communication function before normal service where required by local rules
